```{r}
#| include: false
here::i_am("dashboard/index.qmd")
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(plotly)
library(mapgl)
library(DT)

pub_dir <- here::here("data", "published")
if (!dir.exists(pub_dir)) stop("data/published not found at ", pub_dir, "; check the here() root")
pub <- function(f) file.path(pub_dir, f)
read_pub <- function(f, ...) if (file.exists(pub(f))) read_csv(pub(f), show_col_types = FALSE, ...) else NULL
missing_note <- function(f) htmltools::p(sprintf("Not yet published: data/published/%s", f))
fmt_share <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)

headline <- read_pub("headline.csv")
track    <- read_pub("kalman_track.csv")
ledger   <- read_pub("poll_ledger.csv")
gates    <- read_pub("gates.csv")
shifts   <- read_pub("uniform_shift.csv")
scen     <- read_pub("scenarios.csv")

default_base <- "sen24"
base_info <- if (is.null(shifts)) NULL else shifts |>
  distinct(baseline, label, model_internal, baseline_2p) |>
  mutate(display = ifelse(model_internal, paste0(label, " (model's internal baseline)"), label),
         ord = ifelse(baseline == default_base, 0L, 1L)) |>
  arrange(ord, desc(baseline))

comp <- function(name) if (is.null(headline)) NULL else filter(headline, component == name)
combined     <- comp("combined")
fundamentals <- comp("fundamentals")

ungated <- if (is.null(gates)) NULL else filter(gates, status == "UNGATED")
ungated_for <- function(qs) {
  if (is.null(ungated)) return(NULL)
  hits <- filter(ungated, affects %in% qs)
  if (!nrow(hits)) NULL else sprintf("UNGATED: %s", paste(hits$gate, collapse = ", "))
}
```


```{r}
#| include: false
ledger_ui <- local({
if (is.null(ledger)) missing_note("poll_ledger.csv") else {
  ledger_names <- c(pollster = "Pollster", end_date = "End date", n = "n",
                    talarico = "Talarico", paxton = "Paxton", other = "Other",
                    brown_named = "Brown named", talarico_2p = "Talarico two-party share",
                    weight = "Relative weight", source = "Source")
  shown <- intersect(names(ledger_names), names(ledger))
  ledger <- ledger[, c(shown, setdiff(names(ledger), shown))]
  pct_cols <- which(names(ledger) %in% c("talarico_2p", "weight"))
  htmltools::tags$details(
    htmltools::tags$summary(sprintf("Poll ledger (%d polls)", nrow(ledger))),
    datatable(ledger, rownames = FALSE,
              colnames = unname(c(ledger_names[shown], setdiff(names(ledger), shown))),
              options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)) |>
      formatPercentage(pct_cols, digits = 1)
  )
}
})
checks_ui <- local({
if (is.null(gates)) missing_note("gates.csv") else {
  items <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(gates)), function(i) {
    g <- gates[i, ]
    status <- if (g$status == "UNGATED") htmltools::strong("UNGATED") else g$status
    htmltools::tags$li(htmltools::tags$code(g$gate), " (", g$affects, "): ", status,
                       if (!is.na(g$detail)) paste0(". ", g$detail))
  })
  htmltools::tags$details(
    htmltools::tags$summary(sprintf("Model checks (%d gates, %d UNGATED)", nrow(gates), sum(gates$status == "UNGATED"))),
    htmltools::tags$ul(items)
  )
}
})
```

## Map {height="55%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Precinct projections"
site_url <- sub("/$", "", Sys.getenv("SITE_URL"))
map_gate <- ungated_for(c("regional", "vtd_model"))
if (!file.exists(pub("regions.geojson"))) missing_note("regions.geojson") else
if (!nzchar(site_url)) htmltools::p("Map tiles are built only in the deploy workflow (SITE_URL unset).") else {
  share_breaks <- c(0.2, 0.35, 0.4999, 0.5, 0.65, 0.8)
  share_cols <- c("#b2182b", "#ef8a62", "#fbd5c6", "#cfe3f1", "#67a9cf", "#2166ac")
  share_labels <- c("20%", "35%", "<50%", "50%", "65%", "80%")
  shift_breaks <- c(-0.15, -0.075, 0, 0.075, 0.15)
  shift_cols <- c("#d7301f", "#fc8d59", "#f7f7f7", "#91bfdb", "#4575b4")
  na_col <- "#bdbdbd"
  pct <- function(col) number_format(get_column(col), style = "percent", maximum_fraction_digits = 1)
  pts <- function(col) concat(number_format(list("*", 100, get_column(col)),
                                            maximum_fraction_digits = 1, minimum_fraction_digits = 1), " pts")
  or_missing <- function(col, expr) list("case", list("has", col), expr, "no baseline for this precinct")
  with_na <- function(col, expr) list("case", list("has", col), expr, na_col)
  title <- concat("<strong>", get_column("region_label"), "</strong>")

  layers <- list(list(id = "share", label = "Projected share", col = "mean",
                      breaks = share_breaks, cols = share_cols,
                      tip = concat(title,
                        "<br>Talarico two-party share: ", pct("mean"),
                        "<br>90% interval: ", pct("q05"), " to ", pct("q95"),
                        "<br>P(Talarico two-party share > 50%): ", pct("p_talarico"))))
  if (!is.null(base_info)) for (i in seq_len(nrow(base_info))) {
    b <- base_info$baseline[i]
    layers[[length(layers) + 1]] <- list(
      id = paste0("shift_", b), label = paste("Shift vs", base_info$display[i]),
      col = paste0("shift_", b), breaks = shift_breaks, cols = shift_cols,
      tip = concat(title,
        "<br>Shift vs ", base_info$display[i], ": ",
        or_missing(paste0("shift_", b), pts(paste0("shift_", b))),
        "<br>Baseline Democratic two-party share: ",
        or_missing(paste0("base_", b), pct(paste0("base_", b))),
        "<br>Projected Talarico two-party share: ", pct("mean")))
  }
  for (sc in c("talarico_p95", "paxton_p95")) {
    col <- paste0("scen_", sc, "_2p")
    lab <- if (sc == "talarico_p95") "Talarico 95th-percentile scenario" else "Paxton 95th-percentile scenario"
    layers[[length(layers) + 1]] <- list(
      id = col, label = lab, col = col, breaks = share_breaks, cols = share_cols,
      tip = concat(title, "<br>", lab, ", Talarico two-party share: ", pct(col),
                   "<br>Projected (all draws): ", pct("mean")))
  }

  m <- maplibre(style = carto_style("positron"), bounds = c(-106.65, 25.84, -93.51, 36.5)) |>
    add_pmtiles_source(id = "regions", url = paste0(site_url, "/regions.pmtiles"),
                       promote_id = "region_id")
  for (k in seq_along(layers)) {
    L <- layers[[k]]
    m <- m |> add_fill_layer(
      id = L$id, source = "regions", source_layer = "regions",
      fill_color = with_na(L$col, interpolate(column = L$col, values = L$breaks, stops = L$cols)),
      fill_opacity = 0.8, fill_outline_color = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      visibility = if (k == 1) "visible" else "none",
      tooltip = L$tip, hover_options = list(fill_opacity = 1))
  }
  m <- m |>
    add_legend("Talarico two-party share", values = share_labels,
               colors = share_cols, type = "continuous") |>
    add_legend("Shift vs baseline, Democratic two-party points (grey: no baseline)",
               values = sprintf("%+g", 100 * shift_breaks), colors = shift_cols,
               type = "continuous", add = TRUE, position = "bottom-right") |>
    add_layers_control(position = "top-left",
                       layers = setNames(lapply(layers, `[[`, "id"),
                                         vapply(layers, `[[`, "", "label")))
  if (is.null(map_gate)) m else htmltools::tagList(htmltools::p(htmltools::strong(map_gate)), m)
}
```


## Polling average {height="28%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Polling average"
if (is.null(track)) missing_note("kalman_track.csv") else {
  track <- track |>
    select(-any_of("win_prob")) |>
    arrange(date)
  last_obs <- max(track$date[!track$projected])
  blue <- "31,119,180"
  add_series <- function(p, y, name_prefix, visible) {
    d <- track |> mutate(val = .data[[y]], lo = val - 1.96 * se, hi = val + 1.96 * se)
    obs <- filter(d, !projected)
    proj <- filter(d, projected | date == last_obs)
    p |>
      add_ribbons(data = obs, x = ~date, ymin = ~lo, ymax = ~hi, visible = visible,
                  name = "95% band", legendgroup = paste0(y, "band"),
                  hoverinfo = "skip",
                  fillcolor = sprintf("rgba(%s,0.25)", blue), line = list(width = 0)) |>
      add_ribbons(data = proj, x = ~date, ymin = ~lo, ymax = ~hi, visible = visible,
                  name = "95% band", legendgroup = paste0(y, "band"), showlegend = FALSE, hoverinfo = "skip",
                  fillcolor = sprintf("rgba(%s,0.10)", blue), line = list(width = 0)) |>
      add_lines(data = obs, x = ~date, y = ~val, visible = visible,
                name = "Average", legendgroup = paste0(y, "avg"),
                line = list(color = sprintf("rgb(%s)", blue))) |>
      add_lines(data = proj, x = ~date, y = ~val, visible = visible,
                name = "Projected", legendgroup = paste0(y, "proj"),
                line = list(color = sprintf("rgb(%s)", blue), dash = "dash"))
  }
  p <- plot_ly() |> add_series("mean", "Share:", TRUE)
  groups <- rep("share", 4)
  if (!is.null(fundamentals) && nrow(fundamentals)) {
    fb <- tibble(date = range(track$date),
                 lo = fundamentals$mean - 1.96 * fundamentals$sd,
                 hi = fundamentals$mean + 1.96 * fundamentals$sd)
    p <- p |> add_ribbons(data = fb, x = ~date, ymin = ~lo, ymax = ~hi,
                          name = "Fundamentals prior", hoverinfo = "skip",
                          fillcolor = "rgba(127,127,127,0.2)", line = list(width = 0))
    groups <- c(groups, "share")
  }
  if (!is.null(ledger)) {
    polls <- ledger |>
      mutate(hover = sprintf(
        "<b>%s</b><br>Field end: %s<br>n = %s<br>Talarico %s, Paxton %s, other %s%s<br>Talarico two-party share: %s<br>Relative weight: %s<br>Source: %s",
        pollster, end_date, n, talarico, paxton, other,
        ifelse(brown_named, " (Brown named)", ""), fmt_share(talarico_2p),
        fmt_share(weight), source))
    p <- p |> plotly::add_markers(data = polls, x = ~end_date, y = ~talarico_2p, name = "Polls",
                                  text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text",
                                  marker = list(color = "rgba(40,40,40,0.7)",
                                                size = ~pmax(5, 40 * sqrt(weight))))
    groups <- c(groups, "share")
  }
  shift_bases <- if (is.null(base_info)) character() else
    intersect(base_info$baseline, sub("^shift_", "", grep("^shift_", names(track), value = TRUE)))
  for (b in shift_bases) {
    p <- p |> add_series(paste0("shift_", b), "Shift:", FALSE)
    groups <- c(groups, rep(b, 4))
  }
  share_axis <- list(title = "Talarico two-party share", tickformat = ".0%")
  line50 <- list(list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = 0.5, y1 = 0.5,
                      line = list(dash = "dot", color = "grey")))
  line0 <- list(list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, y0 = 0, y1 = 0,
                     line = list(dash = "dot", color = "grey")))
  buttons <- c(
    list(list(method = "update", label = "Talarico two-party share",
              args = list(list(visible = groups == "share"),
                          list(yaxis = share_axis, shapes = line50)))),
    lapply(shift_bases, function(b) {
      lab <- base_info$display[base_info$baseline == b]
      list(method = "update", label = paste("Shift vs", lab),
           args = list(list(visible = groups == b),
                       list(yaxis = list(title = paste("Shift vs", lab, "(two-party points)"),
                                         tickformat = "+.1%"),
                            shapes = line0)))
    }))
  p |> layout(
    yaxis = share_axis, shapes = line50,
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 1, xanchor = "right", y = 1.15),
    updatemenus = list(list(buttons = buttons, x = 0, y = 1.15, xanchor = "left"))
  )
}
```

## Footnotes {height="15%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Footnotes"
details <- function(summary, ...) htmltools::tags$details(style = "font-size: 0.85em; color: #555;", htmltools::tags$summary(summary), ...)
meth <- details("Methodology",
  htmltools::tags$ul(
    htmltools::tags$li("Shares are Talarico's two-party share, D/(D+R); Brown is excluded."),
    htmltools::tags$li("Headline: election-day poll average, precision-weighted against a fundamentals prior, with polling-bias variance added to the poll term",
      if (!is.null(combined)) sprintf(" (bias sd %s).", fmt_share(combined$bias_sd)) else "."),
    htmltools::tags$li("Polling average: Kalman filter over the polls shown; the dashed segment projects past the last poll."),
    htmltools::tags$li("Best cases are the 5th and 95th percentiles of the combined estimate; their map layers use the joint simulation draws nearest each percentile."),
    htmltools::tags$li("Run date: ", if (is.null(headline)) "not published" else format(max(headline$run_date)), ".")))
shift_tbl <- if (is.null(shifts)) missing_note("uniform_shift.csv") else {
  d <- shifts |>
    filter(component == "combined") |>
    left_join(select(base_info, baseline, display, ord), by = "baseline") |>
    arrange(ord, desc(baseline))
  stopifnot(!any(grepl("\\.(x|y)$", names(d))))
  hdr <- c("Baseline", "Baseline share", "Shift (pts)", "90% interval")
  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) htmltools::tags$tr(
    htmltools::tags$td(d$display[i]), htmltools::tags$td(fmt_share(d$baseline_2p[i])),
    htmltools::tags$td(sprintf("%+.1f", 100 * d$shift_mean[i])),
    htmltools::tags$td(sprintf("%+.1f to %+.1f", 100 * d$shift_q05[i], 100 * d$shift_q95[i]))))
  details("Statewide shift from past races",
          htmltools::tags$table(class = "table table-sm",
            htmltools::tags$thead(htmltools::tags$tr(lapply(hdr, htmltools::tags$th))),
            htmltools::tags$tbody(rows)))
}
htmltools::tagList(meth, shift_tbl, ledger_ui, checks_ui)
```
